summary: The official municipal geoprocessing custodian and cadastral/IPTU custodian were verified, but no anonymous safe native parcel ID plus polygon response was obtained. No sample GeoJSON was retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Portuguese discovery queries, exact text, outcomes and actual result URLs are recorded in city-8159-campos-dos-goytacazes.json.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official municipal Geo portal loaded; page identifies the municipal geoprocessing sector and provides links to maps and data. No parcel feature schema or service endpoint exposed in the accessible HTML/configuration.
Official maps catalog loaded. It exposes planning and thematic map links, including Plano Diretor 2020 Mapa 08 - Parcelamento, but no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry service.
Official data catalog loaded; no public parcel feature download, schema, CRS or safe native identity response was exposed.
Official 4.0 MB PDF downloaded as a planning/parcelamento map. It is not a machine-readable parcel polygon response with stable native parcel identities; no geometry retained.
Official Municipal Finance portal loaded and identifies cadastral/IPTU services and the municipal cadastral custodian; no parcel geometry endpoint exposed.

Official municipal IPTU gateway loaded. The service is property/tax-account oriented; no anonymous parcel feature schema or safe polygon response was exposed, and no account/owner/tax fields were requested.
Official municipal notice documents Planta On-line for project/licensing workflows; it does not establish an open parcel geometry service.
